notes: Real first-turn English user prompts sampled from allenai/WildChat-1M, vetted for scorability, and sampled to the ChatGPT topic distribution reported in NBER w34255 (Chatterji et al. 2025): practical guidance 29%, seeking information 24%, writing 24% (two-thirds of it editing user text), technical help 5%, self-expression 2%. Prompts are verbatim, typos included. `asks` are what the user wanted addressed, NOT factual-correctness checks: this benchmark scores readability, not truth.
